params.body:
## Why

A Vehicle History Report is valid for six months (R S3-8.9). The Car-Pass work list, the heads-up, the daily work list mail and the automatic renewal all read one date: the newest report the platform fetched itself (`carpass_requests`, `success_record = 1`). A car whose Car-Pass came as a link has no such report:
- the link came from Hexon (R P3-2.14), or
- the dealer pasted it after issue 150 (R S3-3.10, #1064).

Such a car never entered the work list, so the garage was never warned when its Car-Pass expired. There are more such cars since #1064.

There was a second bug in the same corner. `Vehicle::getCarpassAlmostExpiredAttribute` compared `null <= $date`, and that is true. So every car without a report counted as "almost expired", and saving its sheet set `carpass_data_checked = 1` (R S3-5.5). A car that got a link later would have been marked checked before it ever showed up.

## What changes

- **A link has a date.** The new column `vehicles.carpass_linked_at` holds it. A `saving` hook on `Vehicle` sets it whenever `carpass_id` changes to a value, on every path: the partner API, a pasted link, and a report we fetched. The same hook resets `carpass_data_checked`, because a new link starts a new cycle, as a new report already did.
- **One definition of the date:** `App\Support\CarpassExpiry`. A Car-Pass counts from the later of our newest report and `carpass_linked_at`. The later one, because a link pasted after an old report of ours is a newer report. Four places read it:
  - the work list (`getDealerAlmostExpiredCarpasses`);
  - the daily mail and the work list check (`Dealer::AlmostExpiredCarpasses`);
  - the sheet (`carpassAlmostExpired`, which is now false for a car without any Car-Pass);
  - the renewal (`getExpiredCarpasses`).
- **The renewal only takes cars that have a report of ours.** It is a billed registration with the garage's own login. A garage that registers at Car-Pass itself, as this one did, should not get one it did not ask for. A newer link on such a car postpones the renewal instead of being registered over.
- **The work list row of a car with only a link** says that it is not renewed automatically and asks the garage to register again from the sheet. The text above the list promises an automatic renewal, so without this line it would be wrong for these cars.
- **The migration** adds the column and gives the cars that already have only a link the moment of the migration, not their creation date. A creation date can be a year old, and all those cars would then be in the work list and in the mail on the first morning. With the migration date, the first of these warnings comes within six months.
- **Docs:** rule R S3-5.9 is new, and R S3-5.5 has a note. R S3-5.6 ("the checked flag is never reset") has been out of date since 2026-09-17, when a new report started resetting the flag. It is not touched here.

## Tests

- `ALinkedCarpassExpiresTooTest`, 5 tests:
  - attaching a link dates it and resets the checked flag;
  - a car with only a link enters the work list seven days before the six months are over, counts in the daily mail, is seen by the sheet, gets the "not renewed" line, and is never renewed;
  - a newer link postpones an old report, while an old report alone is still renewed and its row has no extra line;
  - a car without any Car-Pass is not almost expired;
  - the new line in four languages.
- `CarpassRenewalCycleTest`, `WorklistMailTest`, `WorklistPageTest` and the Car-Pass tests pass, as do PHPStan and pint on the new files.
- Full suite locally: `APhotoWithoutAForegroundIsNotAFaultTest` fails on this workbench without this change too, and passed in CI on #1064 to #1066. `WebsiteFilterBarTest` failed once in the full run and passes on its own, twice.
params.title: Warn when a Car-Pass that came as a link expires
